# maple Provider

Manage Maple dashboards, alerts, uptime monitors, scrape targets and API keys through the public v2 API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    maple = {
      source  = "mapletechlabs/maple"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Reads MAPLE_API_KEY (and MAPLE_API_URL, if set) from the environment.
provider "maple" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A Maple API key (`maple_ak_…`). Defaults to the `MAPLE_API_KEY` environment variable. Alert rules, alert destinations, API keys and ingest keys need a key created by an org admin; a scoped key needs the matching `:write` scope for each resource it manages.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the Maple API. Defaults to the `MAPLE_API_URL` environment variable, then `https://api.maple.dev`. Use `https://api.eu.maple.dev` for the EU region.
